on 12 September, 2024

Author: Pankaj Bhatia
Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
Counsel for Applicant :- Vivek Chandra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of the applicant today in Court is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
3.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.296 of 2024, under Sections 366, 376 IPC,
Police Station Dariyabad, District Barabanki.
4.

The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report alleging that the daughter of the informant aged about 22 years was enticed by someone and she had also taken an amount of Mukesh Kumar Ram vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175643817/
1 Rs.1,65,000/- and certain ornaments.

entities.text: Mukesh Kumar Ram vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she knew the applicant since long and for the purpose of marriage, the victim had gone along with the applicant.
Subsequently, she came to know the exact name of the applicant, she came back.
5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the two statements under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C. coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 06.07.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Mukesh Kumar Ram be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.9.2024 akverma  Mukesh Kumar Ram vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175643817/
